The time when unit became active or started is printed after the "@" character.
The time the unit took to start is printed after the "+" character.

graphical.target @26.400s
`-multi-user.target @26.390s
  `-gdm.service @26.000s +390ms
    `-basic.target @25.950s
      `-dbus.socket @25.920s +25ms
        `-sysinit.target @25.850s
          `-systemd-journald.service @25.550s +300ms
            `-local-fs.target @25.200s
              `-systemd-udev-settle.service @5.200s +20.000s
                `-systemd-udevd.service @4.850s +350ms
